messages:
Talia: quick one — i'm primary until ~18:00 UTC but my flight is delayed. need someone to pick up primary for ~18:00-20:00 UTC. pager still routing to primary; i'm able to shadow until 18:15. @Sam @Minh can you help?

Ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-1234 created — high 5xx rate on inference-prod. Pager routed to primary. link: https://redwood/ops/inc/1234

Sam: i can cover 18:00-19:30 but i've got a calendar at 19:30. not full window. @Rachel are you available 19:30-20:00?

Rachel: I can take 19:30-20:30, confirmed. :thumbsup:

Minh: i can take the whole 18:00-20:00 if that's easiest. prefer one handoff rather than split. i'll run mitigation steps if needed.

Talia: thanks. if Minh takes full that helps. handing over quick checklist: check runbook, LB, restart worker pool if 5xx > 2% for 5m. runbook excerpt below.

```bash
# runbook excerpt (inference-prod / INC-1234)
curl -s https://monitoring/api/incidents/1234 | jq .
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-worker
# verify kv cache health
redis-cli -h redis.prod info | grep used_memory
```

Talia: note — last deploy at 17:10 UTC (release/optimize-batching). if rollback required:

```bash
# rollback to previous image
gcloud run deploy inference --image gcr.io/redwood/release/optimize-batching:previous
```

Ben: any customer impact right now?

Minh: currently minor: ~5% requests seeing 500s, mostly long prompts >2k tokens. no SLO breaches yet. canary fallback 'inference-small' available if needed.

Rachel: i can watch alerts and act. how do we update the pager duty rotation for this swap?

Sam: use the oncall command: `/oncall swap @talia @minh 18:00 20:00` — that creates a swap request and posts confirmation.

Oncall-bot: Received swap request: `/oncall swap talia -> minh 1719123456 1719123620`. please confirm with a reaction within 10m: https://redwood/scheduling/confirm

Minh: confirmed. i'll be primary 18:00-20:00. :white_check_mark:

Ops-bot: Schedule updated: primary=Minh (18:00-20:00 UTC), secondary=Rachel. PagerDuty and notifications updated.

Talia: handoff notes: shadow contact is @Sam until 18:15. if error rate rises >3% trigger rollback and notify SRE. leaving runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-inc-1234

Rachel: copy that. i'll handle alerts/triage as secondary.

Sam: quick helper — for a snapshot of recent error rate: 

```bash
python -c 'from metrics import fetch; print(fetch("inference.prod", last=5))'
```

Minh: taking over. i'll ping when i accept primary and when i hand back. thanks all.

Talia: thanks team — off to airport :plane: safe travels everyone.
